title: Singular Turing bifurcations and spatial canard solutions in nonlinear reaction-diffusion systems
summary: We study a general class of nonlinear reaction-diffusion equations that model pattern-forming systems. The class includes the Gierer-Meinhardt PDE, Brusselator model, and van der Pol PDE, as well as the Gray-Scott, Klausmeier, Lengyel-Epstein, Schnakenberg PDEs and others of activator-inhibitor type. In the limit in which the activator diffusivity is much smaller than that of the inhibitor, these PDEs exhibit singular Turing bifurcations, which have only recently begun to receive attention.
